answers.question: Which Go TUI library?
answers.answer: Bubble Tea (charmbracelet/bubbletea) with Bubbles (list/viewport components) and Lip Gloss (styling). The de facto standard modern Go TUI stack, Elm-style Model-Update-View.

answers.question: How are release binaries built and published?
answers.answer: GoReleaser driven by a GitHub Actions workflow that runs on a version tag push (v*). .goreleaser.yaml declares darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, linux/amd64, linux/arm64 builds, tar.gz archives, and publishes a GitHub Release.
